# KPH Stay (Kaghan Properties Hospitality)

> Premier provider of luxury furnished apartments, serviced suites, and mountain-view vacation rentals in Islamabad, Murree, and Nathia Gali, Pakistan.

KPH Stay operates fully furnished service apartments and mountain chalets offering 24/7 concierge, optical fiber Wi-Fi, fully equipped modern kitchens, uninterrupted power backup, and 5-star hospitality.

## Core Offerings & Keywords
- **Furnished Apartments in Islamabad**: 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK luxury apartments in Bahria Enclave and Margalla Foothills.
- **Furnished Apartments in Murree**: Mountain-view serviced chalets and holiday suites with climate heating in Bhurban and Mall Road corridor.
- **Furnished Apartments in Nathia Gali**: Pine-forest family apartments and vacation retreats near Ayubia National Park.
- **Flexible Rental Plans**: Daily, weekly, and monthly rates for business travelers, tourists, overseas Pakistanis, and families.
